llmsSummary: MyMemos is a free, local-first browser extension that replaces your New Tab page with a private notes workspace. Notes and attachments stay on your device-no account, no cloud sync, no server for your content. Includes a Notion-style block editor with slash commands, markdown paste, images and voice notes, fuzzy search (⌘K), seven built-in themes plus custom themes, and a live browser demo.

faq.question: Is MyMemos free?
faq.answer: Yes. MyMemos is free and open source. There is no subscription, account, or paid tier.

faq.question: Is my data private and secure?
faq.answer: Yes. Notes stay in your browser on this device. MyMemos does not require a login and does not sync your content anywhere, so your writing stays local by default. Uninstalling the extension removes that data from this browser.

faq.question: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.answer: No. Note-taking, editing, search, and attachments work offline because everything is stored on your device.

faq.question: Does MyMemos work across multiple devices?
faq.answer: Not today. Notes stay on the browser where you installed MyMemos. There is no cloud sync between devices.

faq.question: How does formatting work?
faq.answer: Use the slash menu (/), the formatting toolbar, or markdown paste. You can add headings, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, lists, tasks, tables, code blocks, quotes, links, images, and voice notes.

faq.question: What happens when I paste text from other sites?
faq.answer: Markdown paste keeps structure like headings, lists, tables, and links. You can also paste or drop images into a page.

faq.question: Does MyMemos support themes?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose from several built-in themes (including light and dark looks) or create your own custom theme from the theme picker.

faq.question: Are there keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Yes. Use ⌘K (Ctrl+K) for search, standard formatting shortcuts like bold and italic, and / to open the slash menu. Open a new tab (⌘T / Ctrl+T) to jump straight into your workspace.

faq.question: Is MyMemos distraction-free?
faq.answer: That is the idea. Your notes open on New Tab instead of a busy homepage, so capture stays one keystroke away without launching another app.

faq.question: How is MyMemos different from Notion or Evernote?
faq.answer: MyMemos lives on your New Tab, not a separate website or app. It is private by default: no login, no sync servers, and no cloud dependency for your notes. Best for quick capture when you hit ⌘T.

faq.question: Can I try MyMemos before installing?
faq.answer: Yes. A live browser demo is available here. It uses the same interface as the extension. Demo notes stay in your browser for the demo site and do not sync with the installed extension.
